newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AMP says lowers stake in GUD.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AMP says lowers stake in GUD.

text.p: Australia's largest institutional investor, The Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP), said on Tuesday it had reduced its stake in GUD Holdings Ltd to 10.44 percent from 16.06 percent.
AMP said in a substantial shareholder notice to the Australian Stock Exchange that it now held 5.91 million GUD shares, compared with 6.09 million previously.

GUD shares closed one cent up at A$3.22 on a turnover of 2.64 million shares. GUD said earlier it did not know who was behind the large trade today. Based on GUD's closing price, AMP's remaining shareholding would be worth A$19.03 million.
